text:
alex_sales: Urgent escalation: Crescendo Insurance hitting procurement roadblock. CISO says they need signed guarantees around tenancy isolation, KMS controls, and "zero-console" access for support engineers. Theyre threatening to pause if we can't satisfy by EOD. CIO call scheduled 5pm PT. Need SW + Legal here now.
jamie_se: Quick take: Dedicated gives isolated GPU pools and network ACLs but doesn't offer VPC peering. Private (VPC) covers peering + customer-managed KMS. We can mitigate with strict IP allowlists, jump-hosts, and RBAC on Dedicated as interim.
alex_sales: Can we market Dedicated as "customer-isolated tenancy" to procurement? They care about third-party vendor access and egress controls.
maria_legal: Dont overclaim. Suggest: "single-tenant compute pools with configurable network controls". Also need precise list of what Crescendo calls "access" (support, dev, ops) and what data classes they'll pass. I'll draft limited DPA amendment and conditional language by EOD if they provide the data classes.
srinivas_pm: Timeline if they want action: Dedicated pilot deployment about 8-10 business days if infra prioritizes. Private onboarding (VPC + KMS) ~4-6 weeks post-SOW. Recommend offering a 30-day pilot on Dedicated with a contractual option to convert to Private within 60 days.
ben_support: I opened ticket INC-2026-045 and attached our Dedicated runbook + checklist. Also added a quick pricing delta for single-tenant uplift and expedited onboarding. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-045
olivia_cto: Exec suggestion: offer 30-day Dedicated pilot, include role-based access (no console for customer), mandatory audit logging to their SIEM, and 3 months of premium support credits. If they sign, CEO will send a personal note to CIO.
alex_sales: Draft email to CIO (please quick review):
```
Subject: Proposal to unblock Crescendo procurement
Hi [CIO Name],
We understand the procurement concerns. To move forward quickly we propose a 30-day Dedicated pilot (isolated compute pool, IP allowlist, role-based access, audit exports) with an option to convert to a Private VPC deployment within 60 days. Legal will provide a DPA amendment to capture access and retention.
Could you confirm by the 5pm PT meeting:
- data classes (PII/PHI/financial/logs)?
- which personas require access (support/dev/ops)?
- any mandatory KMS/HSM controls or key residency?
Regards,
Alex (Redwood)
```
maria_legal: Add the sentence: "This pilot does not modify our standard data processing obligations; specific access/retention requirements will be captured in the DPA amendment." Then OK.
ben_support: Added checklist link + pricing table to INC ticket. Also started a KMS-RBAC doc in support: https://confluence.redwood.internal/kms-rbac-dedicated
deploybot: Meeting created: Crescendo CIO call  2026-04-05 17:00 PT. Invite sent.
alex_sales: Update after call: CIO is open to pilot but CISO insists on zero-console access for all vendor support accounts and wants proof of audit export to their Splunk instance. Also requested a short security Q&A instead of full questionnaire to speed procurement.
amemoji: :eyes:  
jamie_se: Actionables: 1) produce RBAC matrix for Dedicated (who has console, who has support jump-host) 2) document KMS flow and where keys live, 3) diagram audit-log export (syslog->customer SIEM). I'll pair with infra. Target: first draft by EOD tomorrow.
srinivas_pm: I'll add conversion clause to the SOW: if pilot passes, Redwood commits to a Private deployment delivery timeline within 60 days and credits applied toward Private setup. Also drafting SLA addendum for pilot.
maria_legal: I'll chase Crescendofor the short list of questions theyll accept (so we can avoid full security questionnaire). If they accept, I'll prepare narrow redlines and a conditional amendment.
ben_support: FYIpricing bump for isolated tenancy and premium support documented in the ticket. I included a short mitigation plan for third-party access.
olivia_cto: Approve CEO note if legal and infra sign-off. Also recommend we include 24/7 on-call rotation coverage for pilot window.
alex_sales: Crescendo tentative acceptance pending legal's redlines and infra RBAC doc. Keeping thread open; will post final signed dates. Thanks all. :pray:
